reason: Magma in LaTeX, a Sagebrush-only extension (William's Nov 10 ruling): \magma{}, magmablock and magmasilent run with Run in a Magma session of their own. The runtime gains one builtin, __pyjs_compile_magma__ (Magma code compiled for the Python driver that runs it), so the engine's worker grows; the CLI bundle grows by that builtin and by `sagebrush latex run`/`check`/`render` handling Magma's items (their session script part, its display and check's notes). Measured +541 B (engine/sagebrush-worker.js) and +881 B (cli/pyjs.cjs) by the exact size gate (CI's records, merge probe 72233ed7) against master cd4a16f6; marked +64 B over each.
